newsitem.title: JAPAN: No plan to use tax money for bad loans - Japan MOF.
newsitem.headline: No plan to use tax money for bad loans - Japan MOF.

text.p: Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) is not considering using national tax money to help financial institutions write off bad loans, a ministry official told Reuters on Monday.
"We are not considering any plan at the moment to use public money to deal with the bad loan problems at financial institutions," said the official, who did not want to be identified.
Asked about vague rumours circulating in the stock market on Monday that some Japanese banks may be suffering losses from derivatives trading, the official said: "We have not heard any such rumours."
The official added that the recent heavy drop in Tokyo stocks had not resulted in any tightening of the ministry's control over financial institutions.
